name: services
description: Services — the elaborate object (ES modules). ONE tiny .js data file per service: the definition (advert · provider · variables · modes · needs · output · children · install · update) plus the two pages it produces (ad — the sell sheet · inputs — the way in), its declared progress, and its own gui when it has one, loaded as DATA — never executed — validated, and served to humans and agents alike. Runs nothing: the Scheduler's business, later.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run selftest
